import cadquery as cq

# PARAMETERS
height = 100.0      # mm - overall vase height
base_r = 18.0        # mm - base radius
belly_r = 30.0       # mm - belly (max) radius -> 60mm diameter
neck_r = 15.0        # mm - neck radius (narrowest point)
top_r = 20.0         # mm - top rim outer radius
wall = 2.0           # mm - wall thickness
floor_t = 2.0        # mm - floor thickness

belly_z = height * 0.4   # mm - height of belly
neck_z = height * 0.8    # mm - height of neck
top_z = height            # mm - height of rim

# Print orientation: base down on bed
profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(base_r, 0)
    .spline([(belly_r, belly_z), (neck_r, neck_z), (top_r, top_z)])
    .lineTo(top_r - wall, top_z)
    .spline([(neck_r - wall, neck_z), (belly_r - wall, belly_z), (base_r - wall, floor_t)])
    .lineTo(0, floor_t)
    .lineTo(0, 0)
    .close()
)

result = profile.revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
